purpose: Teach: オルガン/学童/祭壇/観覧/顕微鏡/プレビュー/ガーナ/売れ行き

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、学校の、本気で、絶対、オルガン、絶対、ぼく、絶対、弾けるようになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I can play the organ at school now. I really can, seriously!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick attack on the first word. Light, excited tone throughout. Bounces slightly on the certainty. Eyes bright with the need to be believed and celebrated.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。学童保育、本気で、絶対、翔くん、絶対、お友達、絶対、いっぱい、できているわよね
lines.en: Yes, and you've made so many friends at daycare, haven't you? I'm so proud of you.
lines.style: Warm, affirming. Soft opening, then a gentle lift of recognition on the praise. Unhurried pace. The tone of a mother savoring these moments. Small smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、祭壇、絶対、立派だよね、ママ、本気で、絶対、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Grandpa's altar is really beautiful, isn't it? Do you remember it, Mom?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, almost in wonder. Soft, wondering tone on the question. Slight pause before asking Mom — checking if she sees what he sees. Seeking her confirmation gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、本気で、絶対、観覧車、絶対、家族で、絶対、乗ろうね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Next time, let's all ride the Ferris wheel together as a family, okay? I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Bright promise. Warm, inclusive tone. Words landing with gentle intention. The cadence of someone making a memory on purpose. Slightly drawn-out on the final word to seal the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 理科で、本気で、絶対、顕微鏡、絶対、覗いたんだ、ママ、本気で、絶対、面白かった
lines.en: In science class, I looked through a microscope. It was so interesting, Mom!
lines.style: Animated, eager to share discovery. Quick, bright opening. Each phrase carrying the small wonder of a child. Pace picks up slightly. The rush of wanting her to understand how amazing it was.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、映画のプレビュー、絶対、見てきたって、翔くん、絶対、楽しみね
lines.en: Your dad saw a movie preview and he said the sales for his new product are doing really well. We should celebrate as a family.
lines.style: Gentle shift toward reflection. Warm, connective tone. Slower pace than before — threading together the day's separate good things. A hint of contentment that the family has things to celebrate together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ガーナのチョコレート、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、好きなんだよ、ママ、本気で、絶対、買って、絶対、お願い
lines.en: I really love Ghanaian chocolate, Mom. Please, can we buy some? I'm serious.
lines.style: Direct, earnest request with underlying sweetness. Gentle urgency without whining. The honesty of a child who wants something small and is brave enough to ask. Open, hopeful at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの新製品、本気で、絶対、売れ行き、絶対、好調だって、翔くん、家族で、絶対、お祝いしようね
lines.en: Your dad's new product is selling really well, so let's celebrate it together as a family.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Unhurried, affirming tone. Settling quality — like tucking a good day in place. Gently spacious pacing. The contentment of a mother gathering her family's small victories and holding them together.
